Images are not uploaded by default, unless you set
opts_knit$set(upload.fun = imgur_upload)

messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Image uploads and privacy
parts:
Hi Yihui,

Thanks for the reply. I didn't include this line: opts_knit$set(upload.fun = imgur_upload)

But I was working from one of your example files which included this line that seems to be the culprit:
opts_chunk$set(fig.path='figure/slides-', cache.path='cache/slides-', cache=TRUE)

When removing all options, it embeds the figures perfectly in the html.

Regards,
Michael

messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Image uploads and privacy
parts:
I do not think this is the real culprit. The images were uploaded the
first time you compiled the document because imgur_upload was set
there; after that, the results were cached, so no matter how many
times you re-compile the document, the images will stay on Imgur as
long as you code is not changed. I hope this explains the problem
well.

Regards,
Yihui
